zoneAudit.compared: Road axis, museum east of road, wooded hill to the west, open park south of museum. Existing source placement is consistent in plan.
zoneAudit.applied: Whole-campus context restored; r27 widened avenue and planting setbacks retained. No unsupported new gate dimensions or building relocation.
zoneAudit.limit: Aerial plan does not establish gate height, office dimensions or hidden rear facade; previous dated Roadview models retained.

zoneAudit.compared: Bent/L footprints, long solar strips and small roof blocks on economics1, muted green/olive roof on economics2, south parking aprons between buildings and woodland, rectangular green library roof with equipment.
zoneAudit.applied: Updated four focus roof colors; independent solar frames/roof blocks; asphalt aprons and approximate parking lines; removed generated forest trunks and understory from those aprons.
zoneAudit.limit: Solar module counts, equipment dimensions and bay positions are estimates. The library forecourt and facade are retained from Roadview because aerial shadows alone cannot resolve them.

zoneAudit.compared: Irregular footprint and lower northern wing, green roof, northern park and mapped pond, paved road-facing court.
zoneAudit.applied: Retained tiered massing, stairs and lowered court; updated roof tone and two estimated rooftop service volumes.
zoneAudit.limit: Unseen facade, equipment heights and precise court levels are not measured.

correctionsToPriorWording: In r27 the identifier areaMaterials.wood was mistakenly described as a timber material. It actually represents woodland-colored grass. The remaining green strip over the student-side pavement is removed; actual student timber deck geometry remains in focus-details.

presentation.overview: School-wide orbit view, no replacement of the walking game.
presentation.terrain: Existing coarse AWS raster unchanged, campus ground/roads/parks visible beneath restored buildings.
presentation.groundColor: Original ground texture receives a neutral green luma tint to better match the observed broad grass/forest palette; not an aerial texture.
presentation.walking: Existing three walking zones, avatar, movement, jump, collision and camera retained.
